subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold fallback validation into broader `models status --probe --all` health checks, or defer it to staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but the permanent command surface overlaps existing auth probes and related open model-safety feature requests.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Implement a narrow first-fallback/all-fallback command that starts from configured fallbacks and reports which candidate answered.

options.title: Fold Into Health Checks
options.body: Make the broader configured-model health-check issue the canonical place for validating fallback readiness.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Handle proactive fallback testing only as part of a larger model migration, promotion, and rollback workflow.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow first-fallback/all-fallback command that starts from configured fallbacks and reports which candidate answered.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from recent model CLI/status history and the detailed prior product-scope review on this issue.
